Essay (Paper 2)
  • सामाजिक, राजनीतिक, आर्थिक, पर्यावरणीय व समसामयिक विषयों पर निबंध

GS I — History, Culture, Society, Geography

GS II — Constitution, Governance, Social Justice, IR

  • Federalism, local governance, statutory bodies

  • UP history, art, culture, architecture
  • UP polity/governance, security, health, education
  • Current affairs of UP; NGOs, tourism, innovation (as per notification topics)

GS VI — Uttar Pradesh Special (Economy, Geography, Resources)
  • UP economy, schemes, agriculture
  • UP geography, demography, natural resources
  • Transport, energy, PPP / development issues of UP

details:
Essay

Multiple essays; topics from socio-economic, political, philosophical, contemporary themes as set by UPSC.

GS I — Culture, History, Society, Geography
  • Indian culture — art forms, literature, architecture
  • Modern Indian history; freedom struggle; post-independence consolidation
  • History of the world (industrial revolution, world wars, colonisation, redrawal of boundaries, etc. as in syllabus)
  • Indian society; diversity; women; poverty; urbanisation; globalisation
  • World & Indian geography — physical, resources, industries, geophysical phenomena

GS II — Polity, Governance, Social Justice, IR
  • Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary, federalism, local bodies
  • Statutory/regulatory/quasi-judicial bodies; governance; transparency; e-governance
  • Welfare schemes; social justice; vulnerable sections
  • International relations; bilateral/regional/global groupings; diaspora; international institutions

GS III — Economy, Agriculture, Environment, S&T, Security
  • Indian economy; budgeting; inclusive growth; infrastructure
  • Agriculture; food security; land reforms; LPG effects
  • Science & technology; awareness in IT, space, computers, robotics, nano, biotechnology
  • Environment; biodiversity; disaster management
  • Internal security; border management; cyber security; money laundering linkages

GS IV — Ethics, Integrity, Aptitude
  • Ethics and Human Interface; attitude; emotional intelligence
  • Moral thinkers; public service values; civil service aptitude
  • Probity in governance; RTI; citizen charters; corruption challenges

details:
Official GS heads (Appendix 2)
  1. General Science
  2. History of India
  3. Indian National Movement
  4. Indian Polity, Economy and Culture
  5. Indian Agriculture, Commerce and Trade
  6. Population, Ecology and Urbanisation (Indian context)
  7. World Geography and Geography & Natural Resources of India
  8. Current National and International Important Events
  9. General Intelligence
  10. Special Knowledge of Uttar Pradesh — Education, Culture, Agriculture, Industry, Trade, Living & Social Traditions

Six official areas
  • Opposites (विलोम)
  • Sentences and Correction in Framing (वाक्य रचना/शुद्धि)
  • One Word for Several Words (अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द)
  • Same Uses and Same Nature Words
  • Noun as defined by Adjective / Adjectives (विशेष्य–विशेषण)
  • Synonymous Words (पर्यायवाची)

प्रत्येक क्षेत्र में अधिसूचना के अनुसार निश्चित शब्दों/वाक्यों का अभ्यास करें।

Mains GS I — History, Society, Geography, Environment, S&T
  • Indian History, Art & Culture; Modern India 1757–1947; Freedom Struggle; post-independence to 1965
  • Indian Society — women, population, urbanisation, LPG effects, social justice
  • Geography of India (physical/economic/human) + Geography of Uttar Pradesh
  • Environment & Disaster Management — cycles, pollution, NDMA/NDRF/SDRF, epidemics
  • Science & Technology — space, IT, missiles, nano, AI/robotics, nuclear, biotech (as listed in advt.)

Mains GS II — Polity, Governance, Economy, Ethics, Current Affairs
  • Constitution, federalism, Parliament/State legislatures, judiciary, constitutional posts, NITI Aayog etc.
  • Governance, PIL, policies, ICT in implementation
  • Economy & Agriculture — SDGs, budget, subsidies, MSP, UP agriculture issues, tech missions
  • Ethics & Integrity — Indian ethical thought, utilitarianism/deontology, EI, public service values
  • Current Affairs — Global, South Asia/SAARC, India, Uttar Pradesh, Sports

Paper III — General Hindi and Drafting (mark-wise)
  • Unseen passage (title, explanation, précis) — 30
  • Govt letter summary in tabular form — 10
  • Correspondence (official/demi-official, memo, circular, noting, reports…) — 20
  • Admin/commercial terminology H↔E — 20
  • Idioms & proverbs — 30
  • Grammar (noun, pronoun, adjective, case, verb) — 15; Punctuation — 5; Error correction — 10
  • Varna Vichar — 10; Tatsam/Tadbhav/Deshaj/Videshi — 10; Sandhi/Samas/affixes — 10
  • Vocabulary (synonyms, antonyms, one-word, etc.) — 20; Computer GK — 10

Paper IV — Hindi Essay

Section I (80 marks · ~800 words): Science/Environment/Technology; Economic field; Agriculture/Industry/Trade; Natural disasters.

Section II (120 marks · ~1200 words): Literature & Culture; Social & Political; National & International events; National development schemes/projects.

प्रत्येक सेक्शन से एक अनिवार्य निबंध।
